headline: Philippine peso falls to historic low against the dollar
summary: The Philippine peso fell to a new historic low against the greenback amid expectations of another interest rate hike, while local stocks climbed.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations impact import costs, inflation, and monetary policy decisions by central banks in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Currency depreciation against the US dollar increases import costs and inflationary pressures.

why_moved: Expectations of domestic rate hikes and broader currency trends prompted traders to sell the peso.
